description: Check SAM.gov's exclusion (debarment) list for a company or person — entities the government has barred from receiving federal contracts or subcontracts. Run this before teaming with or subcontracting to anyone: one excluded partner can poison a bid. Match by exact company name or UEI; a state filter disambiguates common names. Records come from SAM.gov's published exclusions extract, refreshed weekly.

name.description: Company or person name, e.g. 'Acme Paving LLC'

state.description: Two-letter US state code, e.g. TX

uei.description: SAM.gov Unique Entity ID — the strongest match key

name: check_exclusions
